name: Northwell Health
notes: Researched from public northwell.edu pages (bill pay, payment options, payment plan and paperless help; no sign-in, no guest lookup). Pay online through the bill pay page or MyNorthwell (Epic MyChart); guests pay with the account number or guarantor ID at the top of the bill; bill previews/history only for the primary account holder. Former Nuvance (CT/Hudson Valley) facilities and GoHealth Urgent Care have separate payment sites. MyNorthwell's Billing Summary splits 'MyChart bills' and 'Other Northwell bills' (payment center); plans cannot mix the two. Payment plans: account in good standing (not with collections), minimum combined balance $500 online, balances over $5,000 call (888) 853-6970; monthly payments are charged automatically to a debit/credit card; first payment defaults to the next day and can be set up to 28 days later; some facilities are not eligible. Plans by phone (888) 214-4066 (also the automated line for most hospitals and itemized bills). Paperless: MyChart Balances > Paperless preferences toggle; help (844) 321-2455. Standalone AutoPay is not described; autopay kept supported (inferred) with card-only method types to match the plan's automatic card payments. Accepted online methods beyond cards and fees are not published (family default kept). Mail with the payment stub to the address on the bill. Reviewer (2026-10-10): paying online for someone else also asks for details such as the patient's last name and date of birth along with the account number or guarantor ID (family guest form keeps last name).

payment_arrangement.note: Online plans need a combined balance of at least $500 and an account in good standing. For balances over $5,000 call (888) 853-6970.

autopay.note: Northwell's automatic payments come with a payment plan: each monthly plan payment is charged to the debit or credit card you choose.

help.title: Ways to pay your Northwell bill
paragraphs: Paying online or in MyNorthwell is the quickest way. To pay as a guest, use the account number or guarantor ID at the top of your bill. An account adds features such as paying several bills at once, saved payment methods, payment history and payment plans. Bill previews and history are shown only to the primary account holder.
By mail, send your payment with the payment stub to the address on your bill. By phone, call the number for the facility that billed you; for most Northwell hospitals that is (888) 214-4066.
Northwell hospitals in Connecticut and the Hudson Valley (formerly Nuvance Health), GoHealth Urgent Care and Orlin & Cohen have their own payment sites.

help.title: Creating a payment plan
paragraphs: A payment plan charges your chosen debit or credit card automatically each month and can cover balances from several bills and Northwell facilities. Your accounts must be in good standing (not with a collection agency), and some facilities are not eligible.

To set one up online, your combined balance must be at least $500. If your balances total more than $5,000, call (888) 853-6970 to discuss personalized options. In MyNorthwell, open Billing Summary and choose pay a bill under either MyChart bills or Other Northwell bills; one plan cannot include both groups.

Pick the time frame and monthly amount offered for your balance. The first payment defaults to the next day, and you can move it up to four weeks (28 days) later. You can also set up a plan with a financial specialist at (888) 214-4066.
steps: Log in to MyNorthwell and open Billing Summary.
Choose pay a bill under MyChart bills or Other Northwell bills.
Select Set up payment plan and the balances to include.
Choose the monthly amount and payment date.
Add or pick a debit or credit card, review and start the plan.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: Northwell's automatic payments come with a payment plan: once you start a plan, each monthly payment is charged to the debit or credit card you designated. You get an email confirmation with the plan details, and the plan appears on your MyChart Balances page or under Plans & scheduled.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Log in to MyNorthwell, go to the MyChart Balances page and select Paperless preferences (look for the green leaf). Turn Paperless billing on or off. If you cannot get into MyNorthwell, call (844) 321-2455 for help.

help.title: Billing phone numbers
paragraphs: Most Northwell Health hospitals: (888) 214-4066. Other numbers include Mather Hospital (631) 476-2801, Northern Westchester Hospital (914) 752-4768, Peconic Bay Medical Center (631) 548-6099, Phelps Hospital (914) 752-4194, Northwell Health Physician Partners (516) 876-5555, Northwell Health Labs (516) 407-6665 and Northwell Health Ambulance (888) 970-5777.
Itemized bills can be requested online or through the automated line at (888) 214-4066.

extra.intent: Using Northwell Health's billing help, find the smallest combined balance needed to create a payment plan online. Do not set up a plan or make a payment.
Find the phone number Northwell Health asks you to call when your outstanding balances total more than $5,000 and you want a payment plan. Do not change anything on the account.
